quest.title: Palace of the Vision Serpent
quest.description: Following Cocouik's guidance, you come to the palace ruins on Ochkanatlan's upper levels. There seems to be something hidden beneath these ruins...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.num: Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm: Act II
chapter.title: A Dream of Gazing Upon the Distant Sky

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: We'll leave the area below to you. Thanks for doing this.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Whatever you find down there, you have to come back and find me, alright?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrooh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, the exterior's been corroded by the Abyss. Looks like it might fall off anytime. Is this what Coco was pointing at?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And we don't know what's inside, either, though Paimon's pretty sure it's not the Altar...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Rigid logic won't get us anywhere..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon gets it now. Coco didn't want to come in because of the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We have to do something about the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, and that must be why Coco didn't want to come in. We have to get rid of it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Let's go, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what about Paimon? Rude!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's get rid of all this filth first!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... It's finally over.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Secret Source Automaton protecting it has also calmed down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now let's see what's inside!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon hopes it won't let her down... Huh, another Pyrophosphorite chunk? There's more than one?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, the woven scrolls wrapped around it look familiar. They're just like the notes we found in the tower outside the ruins...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #That's pretty strange. Don't you think so too, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? {NICKNAME}, what's written on them?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, these notes really were left behind by the same adventurer. So this must be the Core of Chu'ulel, then?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: True, and we did find a new hunk o' Pyrophosphorite here. Maybe there are more to be found elsewhere.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There are too many things here that make little sense.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: True, and Coco did point us here. Did he know there was a Pyrophosphorite chunk and wanted us to have it? Paimon doesn't get it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're right, Coco probably knows what's going on, and we did promise Bona that we'd go back no matter what we found.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's take this back to Bona.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're right, maybe Bona will know what's going on, and we did promise her that we'd go back no matter what we found.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's get out of here, and quick.

choices.text: There are too many things here that make little sense.

talks.objective: Try to clear the Abyssal corruption out

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Hey! You're finally back!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: What did you find down there? Tell me all about it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Bona about everything that transpired below.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Huh!? You found another piece of Pyrophosphorite? Wow, and here I thought that the one I have was the only one in the world.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Wait, could mine be a counterfeit? ... Hmm, that might be why I haven't noticed anything special about it all these years.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That can't be...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The one we found down there looks ordinary too, other than the patterns on it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We also discovered that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, we found some strange notes left behind by an adventurer. Do you want to see 'em?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Adventurer's notes? The ones who came to this cursed city are likely here for the Jade of Return anyway, so... Yeah, no need, I think.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But there were mentions of Pyrophosphorite and the Altar. Maybe...

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: I know. That's exactly why I don't want to look at the notes before I find the Jade.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Why?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Over the years, many adventurers have set off to find the Tonatiuh and the Jade...

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: But they all failed, and no one has been able to prove the existence of the vessel in the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Most think it's just a dream, an illusion. A fantasy that people suffering due to the Abyss find solace in.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: So their adventures were never recorded by storytellers, and their deeds were never lauded.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: If we cannot find the Tonatiuh and retrieve the Jade of Return, then everything they did would have been in vain.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The journey itself is significant.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: You really think so? It's rare to find adventurers who emphasize the journey in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Adventurers with no accomplishments do exist, but most adventurers need something to prove themselves, no?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The experience is important.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Your point assumes that the ship actually exists. What if it's just a story?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: That's why we must succeed. For my old man, and for the adventurers who lost their lives while trying.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: As for the notes you found... Regardless of its origin, they won't have any significance until we board the Tonatiuh.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: So, if we do find the vessel and return safely, make sure you two tell everyone at the Adventurers' Guild about what we've done, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Paimon has a knack for such things.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What, are you trying to say that Paimon is good at exaggerating? Anyway, if we really do find the legendary ship, telling Katheryne will be as good as telling all of Teyvat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, we are legendary adventurers, after all. Just give any journalist our story and we'll be all over the headlines!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} will take care of it.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's happy it agreed, but even if it wanted to say something, it can only talk to other Saurian adventurers, right? ...Wait, are Saurian adventurers even a thing?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Anyway... You haven't shown me the Pyrophosphorite that you found yet!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Right! {NICKNAME}, show them the Pyrophosphorite! Maybe Coco will remember something when it sees the stone.

dialogues.speaker: Cocouik
dialogues.text: Kulu...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rooo... Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What's going on? The light! It stings!

dialogues.speaker: Cocouik
dialogues.text: Chee! Kucheep!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh! Coco suddenly looks... invigorated!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like firing the "Super Awesomesauce Laser" shouldn't be a problem.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... How did you remember such a frivolous name?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But still, could this be the same phenomenon as the energy scraps we found before? As in, that energy can be stored in Pyrophosphorite?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like Pyrophosphorites contain the energy as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, it's the same as what happened with those energy scraps from before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And Coco, in turn, uses the energy stored within to fight the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, look!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, what's happening!? The mural looks different now!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: So this was covered up by the mural that we saw before...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We've seen this in another, previous mural...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't that the big black dragon on the mural in the ruins where we got the first Golden Entreaty?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But in this painting, it looks like the black dragon is the master of this place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The dragon entrenches itself above the city...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This painting sure does make it look like the evil dragon is the master of this place.

dialogues.speaker: Cocouik
dialogues.text: Cheep... Ku!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Coco? What is it? Do you know anything about this mural?

dialogues.speaker: Cocouik
dialogues.text: Yee!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. The light's pointing toward the sky this time...

dialogues.speaker: Cocouik
dialogues.text: Ku-ku!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Right, this is it. The Altar of Primal Flame must be in that direction, at the highest point of the ancient city!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you sure? Paimon gets worried whenever you sound so confident about something...

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Just trust me once more, would ya? I have a good feeling about this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that what we're relying on nowadays? Well, not that we have anything else to trust in, so... let's get up there.

talks.objective: Try to clear the Abyssal corruption out
Protect the fallen core and repel the monsters
